## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request targets the right version branch (`20.0`, `19.0` or `18.0`).
- [ ] One commit per module, named `[TAG] module: summary` (50 characters at most).
- [ ] The tests of the module pass, and new tests cover the change.
- [ ] The module installs and upgrades on a fresh database without error or warning.
- [ ] User-facing texts are translatable.
- [ ] A data-model change has a migration script and a higher `version` in `__manifest__.py`.
- [ ] I have read and follow the [AI contribution policy](https://github.com/odoomates/odooapps/blob/20.0/AI_POLICY.md).
